facts.text: Trailing-twelve-month revenue is ₹38,633 cr, +12% on the prior twelve months.
Trailing-twelve-month PAT is ₹4,903 cr, +24% on the prior twelve months.
Sep 2026 quarter: revenue ₹9,977 cr (+17% YoY), PAT ₹1,085 cr (+7% YoY), operating margin 15.6%.
Revenue has compounded at 10% over 10 years, 10% over 5 and 1% over 3; the last twelve months (+12%) are running ahead of the 3-year pace.
Profit and revenue have compounded at a similar pace over 3 years (2% vs 1%).
Quarterly revenue growth has accelerated over the last four quarters: +4% → +11% → +18% → +17% YoY.
Operating margin has compressed to 15.6% from 17.6% a year ago (−2.0 pp).
Annual operating margin has ranged from 16% to 21% over five years; the latest year (19%) sits inside that range.
Borrowings are ₹4,596 cr against equity of ₹21,735 cr: debt/equity 0.21× (was 0.12× in Mar 2023).
Operating profit plus other income covers interest 38.7× over the last twelve months.
The cash conversion cycle has shortened to 84 days from 99 in Mar 2023 (payable days 71 → 79).
Promoters hold 52.6%, unchanged over a year.
Foreign institutions hold 13.8%, +2.1 pp over a year.
Over 5 years, ₹22,795 cr of operating cash came from ₹31,355 cr of operating profit: 73% conversion; against PAT of ₹20,943 cr that is 1.1×.
Free cash flow was negative in 0 of the last 5 years; cumulative ₹15,070 cr, latest year ₹5,604 cr.
Capex ran at 4% of revenue in Mar 2026, about ₹1,484 cr (averaged 6% over the three years before).

business.what: Asian Paints is a multinational company primarily engaged in the manufacturing and selling of paints, coatings, home décor products, modular kitchens, wardrobes, bath fittings, and sanitaryware. It generates revenue through the sale of these products across retail and project markets globally.

segments.name: Decorative & home décor business
segments.note: Includes decorative paints, home décor, kitchens, and wardrobes.

segments.name: International business
segments.note: Operations across 13 countries in four key regions.

segments.name: Industrial business
segments.note: Includes automotive, industrial, refinish, packaging, and marine coatings.

claims.claim: VAE facility will provide 300-500 bps benefit on relevant products.
claims.quote: we believe that when it really works to its full potential, it should really give us some advantage of 300 bps to 500 bps on relevant products.

claims.claim: New products contribute to about 18% of the revenues.
claims.quote: Today, I'm happy to announce that we keep on testing this benchmark of the new product contribution to the overall revenues and today the new products contribute to about 18% of the revenues

claims.claim: Announced a 3.5% price increase for November.
claims.quote: We have announced an almost 3.5% price increase for November, which has already been announced

claims.claim: Rural markets showed better growth compared to urban markets, a trend continuing from Q4.
claims.quote: We have seen that growth in rural markets has been much better compared to urban markets. This was a trend that we also saw in Q4, and trend continues to strengthen.

claims.claim: The company likely grew slightly higher than the industry average.
claims.quote: What we see is that some of the medium to large players would have got some benefit from some of the smaller players. Therefore, what we see is that possibly we would have grown slightly higher than the industry average.

claims.claim: The company achieved gross margin expansion due to premiumization and low-cost inventory.
claims.quote: There has been focus on looking at premiumization. A lot of focus is on driving a better mix. Therefore, that has been principally one of the reasons of how today we have driven the overall margins. At the same time, there is obviously some benefit of the inventory what we had, which is a low-cost i

claims.claim: Demand has been good in both rural and urban centers, with rural growth slightly ahead of urban.
claims.quote: We got good growth both in rural and urban centers across, that is something which was good. Rural was a little bit ahead of urban growth

claims.claim: The company has taken cumulative price increases of 10.5-11% and plans further calibrated hikes.
claims.quote: where we have already taken close to about 10.5 - 11% price increase, and we are talking of going ahead and taking some more price increases

claims.claim: Competitive intensity remains high with no let-up in discounting across retailers and contractors.
claims.quote: despite the price increases that we have taken, we have not seen any let -up in terms of the discounting in the market.

claims.claim: The VAM-VAE backward integration project is expected to commission its first phase in the first half of the year.
claims.quote: we expect to commission first phase in the first half of this year.

claims.claim: Rural markets performed better than urban centers during the quarter.
claims.quote: One of the things which we saw was, that the rural parts batted better than the urban centres, possibly a good rainfall which has augured well.

claims.claim: Recent price increases by competitors are viewed as an artificial strategy with no meaningful impact.
claims.quote: So as per us, possibly this price increase has no meaning, because anything which is in the zone of about 2 to 3% will not have any impact.

claims.claim: Gross margins were boosted by raw material deflation and internal cost efficiencies.
claims.quote: one of the highest Gross Margins I would say over the quarters in terms of what we have registered, about 44.9%, 200 bps points higher

claims.claim: The company is confident in achieving material market share gains over the next 12-18 months.
claims.quote: All our strategies are geared towards the fact that today we would like to possibly grow to some extent higher than the market.

claims.claim: Asian Paints claims to be the number one integrated home decor player.
claims.quote: today we claim to be the number one integrated home decor player.

claims.claim: New products contribute more than 15% of total revenue.
claims.quote: new products contribute more than 15% of our revenue.

claims.claim: The overall industry growth in Q2 was approximately 3.5% to 4%.
claims.quote: The industry, in the Q2 has just grown by about 3.5-4%.

claims.claim: The company has commissioned a white cement plant in Fujairah, UAE, testing up to 90% capacity.
claims.quote: We just commissioned our white cement plant which has unfolded in Fujairah, UAE. And we have basically tested the product going up to about 90% of the capacity.

claims.claim: Asian Paints is the number one integrated Home Decor player.
claims.quote: we are the number one integrated Home Decor player now in most of the categories, possibly amongst the top players.

claims.claim: Anti-dumping duty on TiO2 will increase raw material costs by 1.5% to 2.5%.
claims.quote: From the point of impact of ADD alone, the impact would be anywhere from 1.5% to 2.5% in the overall raw material cost index level.

claims.claim: The luxury segment is experiencing down-trading due to liquidity or other constraints.
claims.quote: In luxury we have seen some down trading, and it is not just because of the quality... it is a phenomenon which is happening.

claims.claim: The 10% extra grammage offered by new competition is viewed as a discount rather than a consumer proposition.
claims.quote: I think that according to us will not really matter too much in this thing... we see it as a discount in what possibly the new competition is giving.

synthesis.one_liner: Asian Paints accelerates revenue growth to 12% in trailing-twelve-months, but operating margins compress to 15.6% in the latest quarter.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Management maintains its target to keep operating margins within the 18% to 20% band.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Sep 2026 operating margin compressed to 15.6%, missing the guided band despite year-to-date performance averaging 18.2%.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Management committed closer to 700 crores of capex for the full year in FY26.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Actual FY26 capex ran at approximately 1,484 cr, more than double the guided amount.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Management aimed for mid-single-digit value growth for the full year.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: FY26 revenue growth reached 4.9%, aligning with the guided 5% target.

synthesis.credibility: Management shows mixed execution with 1 delivered item, 1 missed capex target, and 2 on-track items out of 14 total guidance metrics, while a majority remain unmeasured.

bull.evidence: Trailing-twelve-month revenue reached ₹38,633 cr, growing 12% on the prior twelve months.
Free cash flow was positive in all of the last 5 years, totaling ₹15,070 cr.

bear.evidence: Operating margin dropped to 15.6% in the Sep 2026 quarter from 17.6% a year ago.
